alt: Four columns: examined in the original code and images, proved formally in Lean 4 and TLA+, tested side by side on the original and the fixed checker, checked on real runs.
caption: Four kinds of evidence, each covering something different. Reading the code, testing parts of a checker, running the whole checker and formal models answer different questions and do not stand in for one another. Side-by-side tests compare the original checker with the version of each fix that was tested, which is not always the latest. One public agent run covers nine fixed tasks: seven regraded with both checkers, and Lean Analysis computed from saved verdicts.
